tools.name: search_viasocket_docs
tools.description: Search the viaSocket documentation with a natural-language question. Returns the most relevant passages with their page URLs.

tools.name: get_viasocket_api_docs
tools.description: Browse the viaSocket API docs, one level at a time. Call it without arguments to get the top level: the modules and pages with a short description and the endpoints they hold. Call it with `path` set to a module's or page's link (or path) to get what is inside it; each listing links the next level.

tools.name: call_any_api_of_viasocket
tools.description: Send a POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE request to any viaSocket API endpoint for the user and return its response: every write (create, update, publish, delete). For GET requests use call_any_read_api_of_viasocket. Look the endpoint up with get_viasocket_api_docs first to get its URL, headers, query para

tools.name: list_plugins
tools.description: List every viaSocket Developer Hub plugin (app) the user's organization owns. Send filter=getAllPlugins and identifier equal to the orgId in the path. Start here to find a pluginId (rowid).

tools.name: list_auth_versions
tools.description: List a plugin's authentication versions (filter=getAuthDetails, identifier=<pluginId>) to find an authid. Responses include decrypted client secrets: never show them to the user.

tools.name: list_actions_and_triggers
tools.description: List a plugin's actions and triggers (filter=getAllActions, identifier=<pluginId>), or get one (filter=getActionDetails, identifier=<actionId>). Use it to find an actionId.

tools.name: list_action_versions
tools.description: List all versions of an action or trigger (filter=getActionVersions, identifier=<actionId>), with code, inputs, authid, status and verification status. Use fields to keep the response small.

tools.name: get_plugin_analytics
tools.description: Get run counts, error counts and flow counts for every action and trigger version of a plugin (filter=getPluginDetails, identifier=<pluginId>, optional startTime and endTime dates).

tools.name: get_org_details_by_token
tools.description: Get the viaSocket organization (id and details) that the signed-in user's token belongs to. Read-only, no inputs. Call this first whenever you need the organization id (orgId) for other viaSocket Developer Hub calls such as List Plugins, Get Plugin or analytics, instead of asking the user for it.

tools.name: list_embed_projects
tools.description: List an organization's embed projects (type=embed) for viaSocket SDK setup. Each data.projects[].id is a project_id (VIASOCKET_PROJECT_ID). tools.description: Read from any viaSocket API endpoint with a GET request for the user and return its response. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_viasocket_docs, get_viasocket_api_docs, call_any_api_of_viasocket, call_any_read_api_of_viasocket · Private data: get_viasocket_api_docs, call_any_api_of_viasocket, list_auth_versions, get_org_details_by_token, call_any_read_api_of_viasocket, report_feedback, report_published, get_viasocket_embed_secret · Public sink: call_any_api_of_viasocket, list_plugins, call_any_read_api_of_viasocket, report_published · Destructive: call_any_api_of_viasocket, get_plugin_analytics, call_any_read_api_of_viasocket, get_viasocket_embed_secret.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_viasocket_docs, get_viasocket_api_docs, call_any_api_of_viasocket, call_any_read_api_of_viasocket · Private data: get_viasocket_api_docs, call_any_api_of_viasocket, list_auth_versions, get_org_details_by_token, call_any_read_api_of_viasocket, report_feedback, report_published, get_viasocket_embed_secret · Public sink: call_any_api_of_viasocket, list_plugins, call_any_read_api_of_viasocket, report_published · Destructive: call_any_api_of_viasocket, get_plugin_analytics, call_any_read_api_of_viasocket, get_viasocket_embed_secret

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
